manifestations.invariant: Applying a batch of operations is all-or-nothing: if any operation in the batch would fail, the accounts file is left byte-identical to its pre-batch state and no operations are applied.

contract_excerpt.quote: apply_batch is atomic: if any operation in the batch is invalid, the accounts file is left completely unchanged and the batch reports a rejection instead of a partial result.
